name: Mobis Parts America PDC - Lancaster TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Black steel cantilever sliding gate across the truck driveway, confirmed in Feb-2025 Street View and z21 satellite. Property is fully enclosed by an ornamental black steel perimeter fence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the gate. The only small structure beside the gate (z21 satellite) is a utility/electrical pad, not a guard booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated entry with no guard shack implies kiosk/call-box/app check-in.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Wide paved apron between S Pointe Dr and the sliding gate, large enough to hold queued trucks outside the gate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically separate dock banks on opposite (west and east) building faces, each fully loaded with trailers.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron with unused paved width; room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Both long faces are lined with dock doors; combined estimate ~90 doors across the building (band 50+). Multi-tenant building so Mobis-allocated share uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Heavy drop-trailer storage on both the west lot and the east dock court; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~75 trailers counted across west and east courts in captured imagery; honest overhead estimate.
